'''Feral Cows''' are the [[Feral Parasites|Feral Version]] of Cows.

== ''Spawning'' ==

* Spawned when a Cow is killed by a [[Gnat]] or [[Lice]].
* Spawns from a Cow succumbing to [[Call Of The Hive]] at [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]] onwards.
* Spawns when an [[Assimilated Cow]] accumulates a killcount of 60 and [[Evolution System|evolves]].
* Spawns in groups of 3 to 6, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 8|Phase 8]] onwards, with a spawnweight of 25, once 4 Cows have been assimilated.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Feral Cows are Melee Combatants.

* Feral Cows attack through contact damage.
* Feral Cows are capable of small leaps.
* Feral Cows are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
* Feral Cows are able to dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* On hit, Feral Cows have a chance to drop [[Remains|Feral Remains]].

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
* Feral Cows, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death, Feral Cows have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Feral Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
* Feral Cows have a chance to drop a [[Gnat]] on death.
